en.quote: …we do not need the metro by a particular date if we end up opening it a month later.
en.head: Passengers entered the stations on October 3, 2019, a month after the “hard deadline” of September 1.
en.body: In April 2019, Beglov called September 1 a hard deadline for opening three stations. A ceremony took place on September 5, but the stations did not open to passengers because work remained unfinished. They actually entered service on October 3; that day, a leak was found at Dunayskaya.

notes: The source quote is an excerpt; retain its ellipsis.
